ios.desc:
BECOME THE SHARPEST SHAPE IN THE VOID.

Geometry Ronin is a high-octane, physics-based action roguelite where precision meets chaos. You are a lone Ronin—a warrior of angles and edges—stranded in a neon void swarming with enemies.

Your mission is simple: Survive.

Inspired by the addictive gameplay of the survivor genre, Geometry Ronin twists the formula by adding a heavy dose of physics. Enemies don’t just vanish; they bounce, collide, and shatter. Every swing of your blade and every projectile you fire interacts with the world, creating a spectacular ballet of destruction.

- SLAY THE HORDE
Face off against thousands of relentless geometric shapes. As the timer ticks, the enemies grow stronger, faster, and more numerous. How long can you stand your ground?

- BUILD YOUR STRATEGY
Level up to draft powerful upgrade cards. Will you focus on pure damage with "Sharpness"? Will you become an unstoppable tank with "Vitality"? Or will you unleash elemental chaos? Every run offers a unique combination of abilities, ensuring no two battles are ever the same.

- MASSIVE COMBOS
Chain your attacks to rack up massive scores. Watch the numbers fly as you cut a path through the swarm. The physics-based engine makes every impact feel heavy and satisfying.

KEY FEATURES:
• Physics-Based Combat: Experience a survivor game where weight and momentum matter.
• Infinite Roguelite Progression: Choose from dozens of upgrades and evolve your Ronin mid-battle.
• High-Octane Action: Fast-paced sessions perfect for quick bursts or marathon runs.
• Neon Arcade Aesthetics: stunning visuals that pop on Retina displays.
• Stats & Collections: Track your high scores, kill counts, and unlockable achievements.

The void is calling, Ronin. Sharpen your edges.

Download Geometry Ronin today and survive the geometry wars!
